# Vendored time zone data

These two files are generated by the TypeScript `cldr-engine` project and committed here so this
build does not depend on the published `@phensley/timezone` and `@phensley/cldr-core` packages,
whose tz data (tzdb 2025b) predates the 2026 rule changes.

| File | Generated by | Source in cldr-engine |
|---|---|---|
| `timezone-zonedata.ts` | `tztool generate` | `packages/timezone/src/autogen.zonedata.ts` |
| `metazone-zonedata.ts` | `cldr-compiler generator code -w zones` | `packages/cldr-core/src/systems/calendars/autogen.zonedata.ts` |

Currently: **tzdb 2026f**, CLDR 48.2.0.

## Regenerating

Both files must be regenerated together. `metazone-zonedata.ts` indexes zones by their position
in the tz package's zone list, and a tzdb release can add or reorder zones.

In a `cldr-engine` checkout (`pnpm install`, then build the workspace dependencies):

1. `cd packages/timezone && pnpm exec ts-node ./bin/tztool generate -t <tzdb tag> -o ./src/autogen.zonedata.ts`
   (clones `eggert/tz`, builds `zic`, needs `make` and a C compiler; `pnpm build` afterwards).
2. `cd packages/cldr-compiler && node scripts/downloader.js && node scripts/generator.js data && node scripts/generator.js code -w zones`
   (needs the compiler built, `pnpm --filter '@phensley/cldr-compiler^...' build`).
3. Copy the two generated files here. In `timezone-zonedata.ts`, delete the `RawData` import and
   drop the `: RawData` annotation.
4. Run the Gradle build; `TimeZoneExternalData.java` and `zonedata.json` are regenerated from these files.

Both files are Apache-2.0, from <https://github.com/phensley/cldr-engine>.
